December 29, 2023 (Compilation) |screen=hd |screenshot=Project Snorlax The Adventures of Snorlax and Cubone.png |en_op=None |ja_op=None |ja_ed=None |olmteam=Polygon Pictures Inc. |scenario1=Midori Sato |storyboard1=Yoshimitsu Saito |director1=Yoshimitsu Saito |art1=Hiroshi Shimada |footnotes= }} '''The Adventures of Snorlax & Cubone''', also known as '''Snorlax and Cubone''' (Japanese: '''カビゴンとカラカラ''' ''{{tt|Kabigon|Snorlax}} and {{tt|Karakara|Cubone}}''), is a set of four 1-minute {{pkmn|animation|animated}} shorts released as part of [[Project Snorlax]]. They were announced on December 7, 2023 through the official Project Snorlax [[Pokémon social media|Twitter]] and [[Pokémon social media|Instagram]] accounts, and were initially released on the Project Snorlax accounts and the official Pokémon English, and Latin American Twitter and Instagram accounts each Friday from December 8 to December 29, 2023. The first and second parts were released on the UK English, French, German, Italian, and European Spanish Twitter and Instagram accounts a few days later, with the third and fourth parts being released on the same day of their Japanese and US release. A 5-minute compilation of all four shorts was released on the official Pokémon Japanese[https://twitter.com/Pokemon_cojp/status/1740658974586814930 @Pokemon_cojp on Twitter] and English[https://twitter.com/Pokemon/status/1740825075970932801 @Pokemon on Twitter] [[YouTube]] channels on December 29, 2023, on the {{pmin|South Asia}}n YouTube channels on February 14, 2024, and the Asian English, {{pmin|Indonesia}}n and {{pmin|Taiwan}}ese YouTube channels on October 10, 2024. ==Blurb== Watch the friendship between Cubone and Snorlax blossom over the course of all four seasons! ==Plot== ;Summer Deep within a forest, beneath the glow of the moon, a {{p|Cubone}} mourns for its mother. Suddenly, some mushrooms start glowing in the moonlight. Cubone gets startled by some spores from the mushroom, and noticing a glow coming from far away, starts making its way there. Emerging into a clearing, it runs into a {{p|Snorlax}}. Cubone gets scared by Snorlax's huge size, but Snorlax is just focused on eating the mushrooms. Snorlax then lays down to rest, and Cubone gazes at it in awe from behind a rock. ;Fall Cubone is still following Snorlax from afar, as Snorlax eats a lot of fruit and berries. Its belly full, it lays down to sleep again. Cubone warily approaches Snorlax and prods it with its bone. However, as Snorlax shifts in its sleep, Cubone is startled and runs away. Its bone ends up on top of Snorlax's belly. As Cubone climbs on top of Snorlax to retrive the bone, it gets bounced into the air due to Snorlax's heavy breathing. It tires itself out due to having fun while bouncing and falls asleep atop Snorlax's belly. Snorlax is later awoken from its sleep and noticing Cubone, smiles and goes back to sleep. ;Winter Cubone is walking around in the snow, and noticing Snorlax's footprints, starts happily following them. It gets dejected after losing track of Snorlax near a huge mound of snow. Suddenly, Snorlax emerges from the mound of snow. Some snow falls on Cubone's head, which makes it happy. Snorlax and Cubone have fun together, with Cubone bouncing on Snorlax's belly again, rolling snow together, and having some fruits for a meal. At night, Snorlax and Cubone look at an {{wp|aurora}} in the sky. Noticing Cubone shivering, Snorlax holds it closer for warmth, making Cubone hug it in happiness. ;Spring Snorlax wakes up in a flowery clearing in the forest. A gust of wind blows some flowers around them, which makes Cubone excited. As Snorlax tries to get up, Cubone dances excitedly, but Snorlax falls down. As it sits back up, it notices Cubone bringing some fruits. Snorlax pats Cubone's head and Cubone happily climbs onto Snorlax's shoulder. They both look at the sunrise. Grateful to have Snorlax, Cubone hugs it with tears of joy. ==Characters== ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Snorlax}} * {{p|Cubone}} ==Cast== {{cast/h|Pika}} {{cast|Pika|Snorlax (Pokémon)|disp=Snorlax|Katsuyuki Konishi|Kabigon|Katsuyuki Konishi|カビゴン|小西克幸|top=yes}} {{cast|Pika|Cubone (Pokémon)|disp=Cubone|Rikako Aikawa|Karakara|Rikako Aikawa|カラカラ|愛河里花子|bottom=yes}} |} ==Staff== {| class="credits-table roundtable" style="background: #{{colorschemedark|Pika}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemelight|Pika}}" |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" ! class="roundytl" width="24%" | Director / Script / Storyboards | class="roundytr" width="38%" | * Yoshimitsu Saito |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" !
